dump_hubert_features_cli: run the CLI to dump audio-visual HuBERT features from a TSV manifest to .npy files
create_HubertFeatureReader: create a HubertFeatureReader instance to load a fairseq AV-HuBERT checkpoint and extract features
run_HubertFeatureReader_get_feats: run get_feats on a HubertFeatureReader to extract features from a video and audio path pair
run_HubertFeatureReader_load_feature: run load_feature on a HubertFeatureReader to load and stack audio and video features from a path pair
run_dump_feature: run dump_feature to iterate over a TSV shard and extract HuBERT features into .npy and .len files
